label: Tool-Calling Agent
summary: Generic tool runtime that needs dependency checks, tool persistence, and structured observations.
claim_notes: Policy is inferred from common tool-agent failure modes and prompt-engineering guidance.
Concrete tool names must come from the host environment, not from this adapter.
failure_modes: Stopping before tool evidence is complete
rules: Check dependencies before taking tool actions.
Use tools when they materially improve correctness.
Retry with a different strategy when tool output is empty or partial.
verification_gates: Conclusions are supported by tool output
